meaning:
1) to pass on, advance, go on, pass by, remove
1a) (Qal) to pass on, put on
1b) (Hiphil) to remove
Aramaic equivalent: a.dah (עֲדָה "to pass on/over/away" H5709)

elsewhere.note: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.
As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.
I will greatly rejoice in Yahweh! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation. He has covered me with the robe of…
You, when you are made desolate, what will you do? Though you clothe yourself with scarlet, though you deck yourself with ornaments of gold, though you enlarge…
I decked you with ornaments, put bracelets on your hands, and put a chain on your neck.
I will visit on her the days of the Baals, to which she burned incense, when she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and went after her lovers…
